Result counts were identical to the September 21 run for every query, and the first eight rows of every query were the same recurring requisition set already scored: the SRE (Toronto), Senior Systems Administrator (Vancouver), Senior Manager Technology Services (Ottawa), Senior Infrastructure Operations Lead (Calgary), bare-metal Infrastructure Engineer (Toronto), AWS Cloud Engineer, Senior DevSecOps Engineer, Senior Design Specialist (Toronto carrier networking), Senior DevOps Specialist, Intermediate Network Automation Developer (Calgary), Application Release Engineer III (Toronto), and Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (Toronto). Title-only screen-outs seen again in the first-8 windows (not opened, consistent with prior-run treatment): Network Analyst III (WAN/LAN/Firewall/QoS, Toronto), Intermediate System Administrator (workstation/MS365 support, Ottawa), Systems Administrator (CyberArk incident support, Toronto), Junior Network Designer (Calgary), SOC Analyst (Toronto).

No CAPTCHA, login, form submission, or application action occurred. The site's inventory for this category appears effectively static day-over-day at this point — worth widening the query rotation or lowering check frequency for this specific source if this pattern continues.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes — September 21 (prior)
items: A first pass completed 2 of 8 queries (DevOps Engineer, Senior DevOps Engineer) before hitting a session budget limit; a follow-up completed the remaining 6 and merged results.
S.i. Systems' Networks and Infrastructure category is a small, static pool (~15-20 distinct live postings recurring across all query rankings, since q= is only a soft ranking signal per the skill).

Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps Engineer each surfaced one new plausible candidate within the first-8 boundary: Network Analyst III (Toronto, WAN/LAN/Firewall/QoS troubleshooting) was screened out by title/summary alone. Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (8-10 years) (Job ID 154794) was opened, read in full, and scored -1/Ineligible below — real Azure/Terraform/Ansible/Databricks skill match, but Toronto Hybrid 4 days/week is outside the reachable-city range.
All retrieval was via a real browser, read-only; no application, account, or form action was used. No CAPTCHA encountered.

method: Eight independent searches were executed with expertise=3 in a rendered browser. Each query reached a real listing state and the first eight results were captured before deduplication. The soft keyword filter repeatedly returned the same small Networks and Infrastructure inventory as the September 21 run — same counts, same recurring requisition set. Current descriptions and applications.md statuses were reconciled; 12 previously validated rows remain, with no new eligible role and no inaccessible posting.
